title: Visiting Fellowships 2027-2028
about: Magdalen College, Oxford, will elect one or more non-stipendiary Visiting Fellows for 2027-2028, usually for about three months, aimed at established scholars. Applications close 11 December 2026; further particulars are on the College vacancies page.
requirements: Generally aimed at an established scholar from abroad or from elsewhere in the United Kingdom
Candidates who completed their PhD less than 7 years before 1 October of the academic year are not usually considered (2025-26 particulars)
The College may also elect Robert S Campbell Visiting Fellows for research in Law

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: Requirement "Generally aimed at an established scholar from abroad or from elsewhere in the United Kingdom" → objective "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

Field "Open across disciplines" (research fellowship) → objective "Apply responsible practices for verification, attribution, citation awareness, confidentiality, and academic integrity when using AI in research activities."
